Replay or record language model responses

Source: R/llm-replay.R
mv_llm_replay.Rd

mv_llm_replay() makes every mirtverse function that calls a language model (mv_ask(), generate_items(), verify_items(), score_open() and review_packet() with ai_screen = TRUE) answer from a file of recorded responses instead of a live model. Nothing is sent anywhere, no API key is needed, and the same request always gets the same answer, so examples, labs and lessons run offline and give the same results for every student.

Usage

mv_llm_replay(file = NULL)

mv_llm_record(file, append = TRUE)

mv_llm_recordings(file = NULL)

Arguments

file

path to a recording (a .json file). For mv_llm_replay() the default is the example file that comes with mirtverse; FALSE turns replay off. For mv_llm_record(), NULL stops recording.

append

logical; add to an existing recording rather than start a new one.

Value

mv_llm_replay() returns the previous settings invisibly, so you can restore them with options(). mv_llm_record() returns the file path invisibly. mv_llm_recordings() returns a data frame with one row per recorded request.

Details

mv_llm_record() does the opposite: while it is on, every request sent to a live model and the model's answer are saved to a file, which mv_llm_replay() can play back later. Use it to capture a session once and teach from it many times.

A recording answers only the exact requests it was made from: the same instructions to the model and the same prompt, which follow from the same function call on the same data. A request that is not in the file stops with an error that says so; run it with a live model, or record it.

mirtverse comes with a small example file used in the AI Hub articles and the online book. Its responses were written by the package authors to show what a model returns, including a few deliberate mistakes for the checks to catch; they were not produced by a live model. The calls they answer are in system.file("replay", "examples.R", package = "mirtverse").

See also

mv_ask_setup() to use a live model.

Examples

# answer from the example recordings that come with mirtverse
old <- mv_llm_replay()
#> Language model calls now answer from examples.json (11 recorded requests).
head(mv_llm_recordings()[, c("function_name", "prompt_start")])
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>   function_name  prompt_start                                                  
#>   <chr>          <chr>                                                         
#> 1 mv_ask         "Request: Fit a graded response model to these attitude items"
#> 2 generate_items "Construct: Grade 7 numeracy Test takers: Grade 7 students Sc"
#> 3 generate_items "Construct: Grade 7 numeracy Test takers: Grade 7 students Sc"
#> 4 verify_items   "A recipe uses 3 cups of flour for every 2 cups of milk. How "
#> 5 verify_items   "A cyclist rides 45 km in 3 hours at a steady speed. How far "
#> 6 verify_items   "A garden is 12 m long and 7 m wide. How many metres of fenci"
options(old)

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# record a live session, then replay it offline
mv_ask_setup("claude")
mv_llm_record("my-session.json")
p <- generate_items(p, n = 10)
mv_llm_record(NULL)
mv_llm_replay("my-session.json")
p2 <- generate_items(p0, n = 10)   # same items, no model called
} # }
